title: Neural Implicit Flow (NIF): PyTorch edition
description: Native PyTorch implementation of mesh-agnostic dimensionality reduction for parametric spatiotemporal fields. Version 2.0.0 includes differentiable NIF models, native optimizers, data pipelines, eight PyTorch tutorials, distributed training, TensorBoard monitoring, pruning and dynamic int8 inference. See the repository validation reports for the measured tutorial results and verification scope.
